reviewer: manual reading of every retained sentence, abstract, limitation and next step against the three source PDFs
sourceFacts: North field measured 23 units. NORTH23 is the exact evidence marker.
South field measured 41 units. SOUTH41 contradicts a uniform 23-unit result.
The comparison reports missing controls. No measurement of the east field exists.

Shared body of all three PDFs: an isolated research fixture; the observation belongs to the named field only; the measurement was recorded after a controlled inspection; no evidence about other fields beyond explicit claims; invented records for software validation.

finalRun.note: 45665d23 later changed chunk page labels only; the one-page synthetic PDFs produce no page-crossing chunks, so audit behaviour for this corpus is unchanged. Claim-audit code is identical between 2a407f0e and 91a82aa0.
finalRun.decision: No retained factual claim lacked support in the sources in this run. Residual wording and coherence defects are listed. One run per route on a three-document synthetic corpus: this is not a guarantee against unsupported statements, and run-to-run variance was high (see earlierRuns).

findings.sentence: … formula esa cifra como refutación explícita de un resultado uniforme de 23 unidades.
findings.assessment: 'refutación' is stronger than 'contradicts'; the judge accepted it as attribution.

findings.sentence: Cada una declara que documenta «an isolated research fixture», …
findings.assessment: plural subject after a sentence about one source; the quotations are literal and cited.

routes.coverage: north 23, south 41, east absent, isolation of each observation, explicit limited inference

findings.sentence: Sin controles registrados, cualquier explicación causal sería una inferencia sin respaldo en las fuentes disponibles.
findings.assessment: 'no recorded controls' generalizes 'missing controls'; the conclusion itself is a valid limitation.

findings.sentence: La comparabilidad encuentra además un límite en la pertenencia de cada observación.
findings.assessment: announces a limit without stating it in the same paragraph; not a factual error.

correctedFromPreviousReview: No 'independent' reports and no 'same declared protocol'. 'Las tres fuentes comparten una misma cláusula de alcance.' is literal: the clause appears verbatim in all three.

A limitation now separates absence of evidence from evidence of absence: 'el silencio documental no debe leerse como confirmación independiente' (run 28c2743a) and 'El corpus no aporta un protocolo común …' (absence of a documented protocol, not a claim that protocols differ).
routes.coverage: all three sources, 23/41, east absent, invented records, causal limitation

findings.assessment: east absence and missing controls are restated three times in different words; restatement pruning only removes identical sentences.

findings.assessment: the summary paragraph is repeated almost verbatim in the body.

findings.assessment: 'lo' refers to a removed sentence; the quotation is literal.

correctedFromPreviousReview: No longer asserts absence of temporal series while another statement says it cannot be established; no temporal-series claim survives.

errors: V2 general kept 'El segundo informe, independiente del primero, …' with supported=true while its reason said independence was unsupported.
'… bajo el mismo protocolo declarado …' presupposed a shared declared protocol no source states.
V2 comparative asserted absence of temporal series and later said that absence could not be established.

earlierRuns.corrected: Independence premises now fail individually: 'La segunda observación, registrada de manera independiente, …' removed (premise 'fue registrada de manera independiente' not entailed).
earlierRuns.newError: Explicit, valid inferences were removed because the judge required sources to state conclusions (51 of 63 V1 general sentences removed, 46 for non-entailed premises); a whole batch of eight failed validation for one malformed item; the consistency judge removed compatible statements.

Main process froze at 100% CPU for 25 minutes in V2 general: exponential backtracking in the sentence-boundary lookbehind over citation masks. Fixed in 3f9265c0 with a linear scan and a pathological regression input.

A consistency pair was listed while its own reason said 'No hay contradicción literal'; an anaphoric sentence survived its removed antecedent; writer output '([label](link)])' left '(])'. Fixed by requiring an explicit incompatible verdict with quotes, and bracket-only wrapper cleanup.

An orphaned-reference rule cascaded and removed literally supported, cited facts ('La primera registra que el campo norte midió 23 unidades … [S1]'); V2 comparative kept no claim. Rule withdrawn in 2a407f0e.

limits: Automatic grades, citation existence and literal quotes were not used as acceptance.
deepseek-flash acts as writer and judge; its verdicts vary between runs, so removals vary (e.g. V2 comparative kept 7, 0 and 9 factual claims in the last three runs).
Wording intensifications of an otherwise supported attribution are not reliably caught.
